title: Take a throat swab: hold the tongue down with a tongue blade and rub both tonsillar pillars, touching nothing else
instruction: Take a throat swab from the manikin: hold its tongue down with the tongue blade, rub both tonsillar pillars with the swab without touching anything else, then take the swab out, then the blade.
context: Medical assistants (O*NET 31-9092.00, about 811,000 US jobs, BLS 2024) collect throat swabs for rapid strep tests and cultures many times a day in physician offices and urgent care. The procedure: hold the tongue down with a tongue blade, rub the swab over both tonsillar pillars or the back of the throat, and keep it off the tongue, teeth, cheeks and uvula going in and coming out. A swab that touches anything else picks up mouth flora and gives a false result; a blade pushed onto the back of the tongue makes the patient gag. One hand keeps the tongue down against its push while the other steers a 2.5 mm swab through a 3 cm gap past the uvula and back out.
setup: Station table; positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y to the robot's left), arm bases at y +-30.5. Training head: an adult oral and nasal swab simulator head (CAE Medicor class; skin sRGB 224, 172, 145) on a stand facing the robots, 6 kg, loose on the bench: lip plane at x 46, mouth centre 23 cm above the bench on y 0, opening 5.0 cm wide and 4.0 cm tall, incisor edges 1.6 cm above and below the centre. Inside: cheeks 2.8 cm either side of the midline, hard palate 2.2 cm above the centre; the uvula (8 mm across, from 4 to 18 mm above the centre) 8.4 cm behind the lips; red (176, 38, 52) tonsillar pillars 7.5 to 10 cm behind the lips with 3.2 cm between them; the back wall of the throat 10 cm behind the lips. The tongue (201, 104, 114) runs from 1.6 to 9 cm behind the lips; at rest its top is 2 mm above the mouth centre and closes the way to the pillars; pressed, it gives way up to 16 mm against a spring (0.6 N at rest, 1.3 N fully down). Instrument stand (dark grey, 1.5 kg) between the arms: posts 14 cm tall at x 33.5 and 40.5 on y +12 hold a 6 x 3/4 in wooden tongue depressor (15.2 x 1.8 x 0.18 cm, 4 g, sRGB 222, 199, 158) lying flat, handle end toward the robots at x 26.0 (0 to 1.2 cm further forward per trial); slotted posts at x 31 and 39 on y -9 hold a culture swab (BD BBL CultureSwab class, 17 cm: blue 12 mm cap, 2.5 mm shaft, rayon tip 5 mm across and 15 mm long; 4 g), cap end at x 25.0 (0 to 1.2 cm further forward per trial), tip toward the head.
scoring: Score 0 if at any point the swab tip touches the lips, teeth, palate, cheeks, floor of the mouth, uvula, tongue, the tongue blade or the bench (contaminated), or the blade's inner end goes past the front two thirds of the tongue (more than 66 mm behind the lips: gag). At the end: 0.25 when the swab tip has touched one tonsillar pillar (in contact 0.1 s), 0.5 both pillars; 0.75 both, and the swab is out of the mouth (tip 2 cm or more in front of the lips and 3 cm or more above the bench, touching nothing); 1.0 (success, held 1 s) that, and no part of the blade left in the mouth. Otherwise 0, including doing nothing.
reset_notes: Take the swab and the blade out of the mouth and let the tongue spring back up. Lay the blade on its two posts, handle end toward the robots at x 26.0 to 27.2 cm, and the swab in its two slotted posts, cap end at x 25.0 to 26.2 cm, tip toward the head (the seed draws both offsets). Put the head back with its lip plane at x 46 on y 0. Real trial: wipe the pillars and re-mark them, re-dust the forbidden surfaces (see README) and use a fresh swab.
fidelity: PhysX at 240 Hz. The head is rigid boxes and one cylinder sized from adult anatomy; its soft tongue is a rigid block on a sprung slider (0.6 to 1.3 N, estimate). Touches are scored from geometry: the swab tip counts as touching a surface within 0.8 mm. Blade, swab and stand are rigid; the swab's centre of mass is set mid-shaft (its cap is a hollow tube). Blade and swab masses are estimates. The seed shifts both tools along their rests.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (2,400 steps, seed 0); scripted demo: 1.0 (seeds 0-7, success at steps 1158-1191); do nothing, random joints, random reaches: 0.0
